+from boto3.dynamodb.conditions import Attr, Key
+
+from database_client import get_table
+from database_models import build_response
+
+
+def query_documents(payload, config=None):
+    table, cfg = get_table(config)
+    field = payload.get("field") or cfg["key_field"]
+    value = payload["value"]
+    use_partition_key = payload.get("use_partition_key", False)
+    if use_partition_key or field == cfg["key_field"]:
+        items = table.query(KeyConditionExpression=Key(field).eq(value)).get("Items", [])
+    else:
+        items = table.scan(FilterExpression=Attr(field).eq(value)).get("Items", [])
+    return build_response(items, field=field, value=value)
*** End Patch

+from decimal import Decimal
+
+from boto3.dynamodb.conditions import Attr
+
+from database_client import get_table
+from database_models import build_response, normalize_document
+
+
+def conditional_update(payload, config=None):
+    table, cfg = get_table(config)
+    doc = normalize_document(payload["document"])
+    key = {cfg["key_field"]: payload["id"]}
+    version_field = payload.get("version_field", cfg["version_field"])
+    expected_version = payload.get("expected_version")
+    update_expression = payload["update_expression"]
+    expression_values = payload.get("expression_values", {})
+    if expected_version is not None:
+        condition = Attr(version_field).eq(Decimal(str(expected_version)))
+    else:
+        condition = Attr(cfg["key_field"]).exists()
+    response = table.update_item(
+        Key=key,
+        UpdateExpression=update_expression,
+        ExpressionAttributeValues={k: normalize_document(v) for k, v in expression_values.items()},
+        ConditionExpression=condition,
+        ReturnValues="ALL_NEW",
+    )
+    return build_response(response.get("Attributes"), id=payload["id"], updated=doc)
*** End Patch

+import base64
+
+from database_client import get_s3_client
+from database_models import build_response
+
+
+def record_export_archive(payload, config=None):
+    client, cfg = get_s3_client(config)
+    bucket = payload.get("bucket") or cfg["bucket_name"]
+    key = payload.get("key") or f"exports/{payload['id']}.json"
+    body = payload.get("content")
+    if isinstance(body, str):
+        data = body.encode("utf-8")
+    elif isinstance(body, bytes):
+        data = body
+    else:
+        data = base64.b64decode(payload.get("content_base64", ""))
+    client.put_object(Bucket=bucket, Key=key, Body=data)
+    return build_response({"bucket": bucket, "key": key})
*** End Patch
